merged_yaml:
---
stages:
- ".pre"
- test
- ".post"
packaging-tools:
  stage: test
  image: python:3.13-bookworm@sha256:227b6570d6ee07061ae6ca2eb04dedfb6d2b34045835f343065b9869e4d427ea
  tags:
  - k8s
  - amd64
  rules:
  - changes:
    - tools/**/*
    - tests/**/*
    - dependencies/*.py
    - ".gitlab-ci.yml"
  script:
  - python3 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -v
".rpm-native-installed":
  stage: test
  tags:
  - k8s
  - arm64
  rules:
  - if: $RPM_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION == "core21"
  script:
  - python3 -B -W error tools/qualify-installed.py "$RPM_MANIFEST" --output results/native-installed
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
    - results/native-installed/
    expire_in: 14 days
rpm-fedora-arm64:
  stage: test
  tags:
  - k8s
  - arm64
  rules:
  - if: $RPM_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION == "core21" && ($RPM_NATIVE_TARGET == null || $RPM_NATIVE_TARGET
      == "fedora")
  script:
  - python3 -B -W error tools/qualify-installed.py "$RPM_MANIFEST" --output results/native-installed
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
    - results/native-installed/
    expire_in: 14 days
  extends: ".rpm-native-installed"
  image: registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora@sha256:bd539c7c03d6ee316e0f9396d4a44e6a137d2c4cd6bf6a019f608cfa2fba6fa6
  variables:
    RPM_MANIFEST: qualification/core21-fedora-aarch64.json
  before_script:
  - dnf -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False install python3 ca-certificates shadow-utils
    util-linux findutils
rpm-leap-arm64:
  stage: test

  - k8s
  - arm64
  rules:

  extends: ".rpm-native-installed"
  image: opensuse/leap@sha256:e8997b5b4278bb91ef108750b5d103e2d55bbf1f22965bb46a2ba3b35487b292
  variables:
    RPM_MANIFEST: qualification/core21-leap-aarch64.json
